$comment: National nuclear regulators, by the ISO 3166-1 code of the country a facility row names, as Wikidata items. The Info card links the regulator's official website (Wikidata P856, resolved by src/tools/fetch-wikidata-references.mjs, never typed here) for the nuclear facility rows of that country: categories NUCL and NUCF, and STORE rows whose kind names radioactive waste. Each item was read on `checked` and states the country (P17 or P1001) and an official website. A country with no item here gets no regulator link. The link names the country's national regulator; it does not say that body licenses the site, and rows whose kind matches excludeKinds (US Department of Energy national laboratories, which DOE oversees) get none.
